outcome: Composite adverse neonatal outcome (neonatal death, encephalopathy, therapeutic hypothermia, seizures, intubation, and respiratory distress)
cohort: 2081 singleton, term, nonanomalous, liveborn neonates delivered by scheduled cesarean delivery under regional anesthesia
finding: Fetuses with fetal acidemia at the time of a scheduled cesarean delivery were at a significantly increased risk for adverse neonatal outcomes compared to those without fetal acidemia, regardless of the type of acidemia.
